cards.meaning: a sudden or heavy fall or collapse -- of a price, a rank, or a condition -- carrying weight, not a routine change
cards.example: Isa na namang pagbagsak ng piso sa bagong pinakamababang antas -- 62.41 kada dolyar.
cards.exampleMeaning: Another fall for the peso to a new record low -- P62.41 to the dollar.
cards.note: Broader, neutral 'pagbaba' can describe any decrease, even a gentle one -- pagbaba ng temperatura. 'Pagbagsak' carries weight and usually suddenness -- it implies crisis or failure, not just an ordinary change, which is why it's the right word for a currency hitting a record low, not a routine dip.
cards.tiesTo: Peso hits record low P62.41; BSP Gov. Remolona warns continued intervention will run down reserves

cards.meaning: rushing or undue haste -- doing something quickly at the expense of care or scrutiny
cards.example: Inaprubahan ng komite ang badyet ng Malacañang sa loob lamang ng 25 minuto -- tunay na pagmamadali.
cards.exampleMeaning: The committee approved Malacañang's budget in just 25 minutes -- genuine haste.
cards.note: Not the same as neutral 'bilis' (speed), which carries no judgment. 'Pagmamadali' implies something is being sacrificed for speed -- care, process, scrutiny -- so using the word already signals suspicion about the outcome.
cards.tiesTo: House committee approves Malacañang's 2027 budget 37-5 in 25 minutes, citing 'interbranch courtesy'

cards.meaning: bargaining chip, leverage -- something deliberately accumulated to spend at the negotiating table later
cards.example: 双方都想在峰会前多攒一些筹码。
cards.examplePinyin: shuāngfāng dōu xiǎng zài fēnghuì qián duō zǎn yīxiē chóumǎ
cards.exampleMeaning: Both sides want to stack up more leverage before the summit.
cards.note: 书面语/formal in this usage, common in diplomacy and negotiation coverage. 优势 (advantage) is a general edge from being better at something. 筹码 is accumulated on purpose and is crucially spendable -- built up specifically to trade away for something else, the vocabulary of a negotiation rather than a scoreboard.
cards.tiesTo: US and China trade sanctions ahead of Xi's September 24 Washington visit

cards.meaning: is both X and Y -- one single thing genuinely serving two functions or identities at once
cards.example: 这波制裁既是施压手段，也是峰会前的筹码。
cards.examplePinyin: zhè bō zhìcái jìshì shīyā shǒuduàn, yěshì fēnghuì qián de chóumǎ
cards.exampleMeaning: This round of sanctions is both a pressure tactic and a bargaining chip ahead of the summit.
cards.note: 书面语/formal, analytical register. Casual 又…又… lists two simultaneous qualities equally, usually about a personal state (tired and hungry). 既是…也是… is the construction for saying a single policy or action carries two distinct identities or purposes at once -- reframing rather than just listing.
cards.tiesTo: US and China trade sanctions ahead of Xi's September 24 Washington visit, serving as both pressure and leverage
